schema_note: Prior-run candidate index built at stage 0. Handed to gap hunters as do-not-restate, and to the constraint gate for the archive check.

candidates.one_liner: For Indian shade-coffee / rubber / cocoa smallholders facing EUDR, type every post-2020 canopy-loss event as {shade-tree pruning, crop renovation, genuine forest conversion} from Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 + NICFI, instead of the binary 'deforestation alert' current maps emit.
candidates.reason: Not a generic artifact; imagery is the only signal; delta is event-typing (a new output space), not geography.

candidates.one_liner: Refine and confidence-calibrate the FTW global 10 m field-boundary product in Indian smallholder landscapes using AlphaEarth embeddings + cross-year boundary stability, benchmarked on the FTW-India 10k labels.
candidates.reason: As written, 'apply FTW to India' is regional transfer: FTW-India already exists and the global map already covers India. Fails C7 unless the contribution is redefined.
candidates.reframe: Contribution becomes a METHOD + BENCHMARK, not a map: (1) a calibrated confidence model for FTW-global that uses AlphaEarth embedding neighbourhood consistency and 2024↔2025 polygon stability as features, trained/evaluated on the FTW-India 10k labels and AI4SmallFarms; (2) a 'boundary reliability' benchmark with a fixed protocol so anyone can report smallholder performance honestly; (3) an error taxonomy (over-merge / over-split / bund-vs-field) with per-class confidence. If the adversarial search finds FTW's own PRUE / confidence follow-ups already do this, drop the candidate.

candidates.one_liner: Grassland mowing-event detection from Sentinel-1 coherence + Sentinel-2 for CAP compliance.
candidates.reason: Done repeatedly (Estonia, Hungary, JRC). No technical delta stated.

candidates.one_liner: Classify the FATE of paddy residue per field in Punjab — burnt / incorporated in-situ / baled ex-situ / left standing — from Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 in the 10–20 day harvest-to-sowing window, so CRM subsidy payouts can be verified without field visits.
candidates.reason: Burn detection is saturated (PRSC, CEEW, S1+S2 papers). Zero-till detection from S2 SWIR and S1/S2/Planet tillage-practice mapping already exist for Indian smallholders. A 4-class residue-fate classifier sits close to 'same method, new labels'.
candidates.reframe: Two options. (a) Make partial-burn quantification the core (CEEW explicitly flags partial vs complete burn as unresolved) with a sub-field burn-fraction output and an evasion-behaviour analysis (night burns, edge burns) — a measurement problem, not a classification one. (b) Make the SUBSIDY-VERIFICATION SYSTEM the contribution: link the classifier to Punjab's CRM machinery-subsidy and bio-decomposer plot lists and measure verification precision at the payout decision. Option (a) is more publishable; (b) more hireable at SatSure-type firms. Either must survive an adversarial search on 'residue management practice mapping Sentinel Punjab'.

candidates.one_liner: Crop nitrogen status mapping from free EnMAP / PRISMA hyperspectral imagery.
candidates.reason: Hyperspectral N-mapping is a mature sub-field; one-liner has no delta beyond 'use the free sensor'.

candidates.one_liner: Paddy transplanting-date estimation from Sentinel-1 for PMFBY prevented-sowing claims.
candidates.reason: S1 rice phenology is standard (MNCFC/FASAL use it). Only the use-case is new — regional/application transfer.

candidates.one_liner: Village-level in-season crop-failure early warning from drift in AlphaEarth embedding space, evaluated against PMFBY crop-cutting-experiment yields.
candidates.reason: AlphaEarth public embeddings are ANNUAL — no in-season signal exists in the free product. As written, the data does not exist.
candidates.reframe: Apply to Google's Custom Satellite Embeddings academic program (deadline 15 Oct 2026) for monthly/on-demand embeddings; if declined, replace with your own lightweight S1+S2 monthly embedding (a small autoencoder on GEE exports) and evaluate whether drift in that space precedes reported PMFBY losses at village level. Ground truth: district/tehsil-level CCE yields and notified-calamity lists.

candidates.one_liner: Detect eco-scheme fallow-land non-compliance from Sentinel-2.
candidates.reason: Hungary nationwide (2022) and JRC CbM already do this.

candidates.one_liner: Flag LPIS parcels whose declared geometry diverges from observed field geometry using the FTW global 2024/2025 boundary product as an independent reference, and type the divergence (merge / split / encroachment / mis-registration).
candidates.reason: JRC and national agencies already run LPIS quality assessment; 'compare LPIS to a boundary map' is a known workflow. Delta must be the typing and the use of FTW-global.
candidates.reframe: Contribution = an open divergence taxonomy + detector (merge / split / encroachment / registration offset) with per-type accuracy on EuroCrops/AI4Boundaries ground truth, and a study of WHERE FTW-global disagrees with LPIS systematically (which is also a useful error analysis of FTW itself). Keep only if this analysis does not exist.

candidates.one_liner: Post-flood cropland damage extent and recovery from Sentinel-1 for insurers.
candidates.reason: SAR flood mapping over cropland is textbook; nothing here but the region.

candidates.one_liner: Map groundwater-irrigated vs rainfed fields in Punjab from Sentinel time series.
candidates.reason: Irrigation mapping from S1/S2 exists for India already.

candidates.one_liner: Multi-year stable management-zone delineation from Sentinel-2.
candidates.reason: This is the FieldView / EOSDA product. Auto-fail pattern: NDVI time series + off-the-shelf method.

candidates.one_liner: Few-shot crop-type mapping without LPIS labels using AlphaEarth embeddings.
candidates.reason: Auto-fail pattern: crop type classification as the whole contribution.

candidates.one_liner: Kharif sowing-failure / re-sowing detection from S1+S2 for seed companies.
candidates.reason: Sowing-date detection is established; new user, same method.

candidates.one_liner: Turn a single EUDR GPS point (<4 ha smallholder plot) into an audit-ready plot polygon + 2020-baseline verdict from NICFI imagery, for tree crops where boundaries are hidden under canopy.
candidates.reason: Some compliance vendors already offer point→boundary suggestion; as a standalone it is one component and one sentence. Scope floor 2/5.
candidates.reframe: Fold into S01 as the plot-definition component. Not a standalone FYP.

candidates.one_liner: Stubble-burning detection in Punjab from Sentinel-2 burn indices.
candidates.reason: PRSC, CEEW and S1+S2 papers already cover this. Crowded, no delta.

candidates.one_liner: Map shifting-cultivation (jhum) expansion into forest edge in NE India from NICFI.
candidates.reason: Jhum mapping from Planet/Sentinel exists; the one-liner adds only the sensor.

candidates.one_liner: Winter cover-crop (GAEC 6) compliance from Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2.
candidates.reason: Cover-crop detection is a JRC CbM marker already.

candidates.one_liner: Field-level yield-gap estimation from Sentinel-2 time series.
candidates.reason: Auto-fail pattern: yield prediction with no further specificity.

candidates.one_liner: Optimise PMFBY crop-cutting-experiment placement via satellite stratification.
candidates.reason: MNCFC already stratifies CCEs with satellite data; sampling-design delta not stated.

candidates.one_liner: Field-level early warning of vegetable-import shocks to Singapore by monitoring its actual source basket (Cameron Highlands, Johor, etc.) with Sentinel-1/2 crop anomalies, and measuring lead time against Singapore wholesale/retail price series.
candidates.reason: SG is C1-exempt anyway; not generic; not regional transfer (JRC ASAP is coarse and global, SFA's new dashboard is logistics-based). Sensor rules don't apply — imagery is over Malaysia, not SG farmland.

candidates.one_liner: Solar-farm encroachment on cropland from Sentinel-2.
candidates.reason: Solar-park mapping from S2 is established; and it is land-use, not agri decision support.

candidates.one_liner: Learn a panel-free, cross-date radiometric harmonisation for consumer multispectral drone flights using overlap consistency between raw frames, and release a benchmark on IMPaCT-UAV (Vijayawada paddy, all growth stages) measuring whether growth-stage change is preserved after harmonisation.
candidates.reason: Radiometric block adjustment exists but needs panels / DLS; a learned self-supervised version with a public benchmark is a technical delta. Data is open and Indian.

candidates.one_liner: Verify pesticide spray coverage from post-spray drone RGB imagery for Namo Drone Didi operators.
candidates.reason: No accessible dataset of post-spray imagery exists; self-collected flights are out of scope per C2 extra_check. Ground truth (deposition) would need water-sensitive paper trials. Kept on the page: two degrees from D01/D04 if a partner (Aonic, a KVK) supplies flights.

candidates.one_liner: Few-shot crop/weed segmentation with SAM / DINOv2 on WeedsGalore.
candidates.reason: Auto-fail pattern: generic detection on a public dataset; 'fine-tune X on Y' describes it fully.

candidates.one_liner: Stitch-free plant-level detection: run detectors on raw overlapping drone frames and fuse per-plant predictions by multi-view geometric consensus with uncertainty, never building an orthomosaic; benchmark against the Pix4D/ODM orthomosaic pipeline on IMPaCT-UAV.
candidates.reason: Two 2025 papers (EasyIDP raw→DOM mapping for organ-level detection; raw-frame palm detection) already argue raw frames beat orthomosaics. Their georeferencing still passes through a DOM or SfM solution, but the headline claim is taken.
candidates.reframe: Make the contribution the FUSION, not the raw-frame observation: per-plant detections from N overlapping frames are associated via direct georeferencing (GPS + IMU + flat- field assumption) and fused with a probabilistic consensus that yields a per-plant confidence and a geolocation uncertainty ellipse — no SfM, no DOM, runs on a laptop in the field. Benchmark vs ODM-orthomosaic pipeline on IMPaCT for count accuracy, geolocation error, and wall-clock. Pair with D01 as one 'raw-frame agronomy' system if you want a bigger FYP.

candidates.one_liner: Missing-hill / transplant-gap detection in paddy from IMPaCT drone imagery.
candidates.reason: Rice seedling counting / gap detection exists (China); only the dataset is new.

candidates.one_liner: Use IMPaCT drone orthomosaics as dense labels to train Sentinel-2 paddy-stage models.
candidates.reason: Drone-as-reference for satellite is a well-reviewed pattern; and 5 acres is ~20 Sentinel pixels.

candidates.one_liner: Drone SfM canopy height as a biomass proxy vs NDVI.
candidates.reason: Crowded, no delta.

candidates.one_liner: Temporal crop/weed instance tracking on PhenoBench.
candidates.reason: Public-dataset benchmark chasing; one sentence describes it.

candidates.one_liner: Verify vine grubbing-up and detect abandoned / dead-vine rows across years from France's open 20 cm BD ORTHO aerial imagery, to audit the 2024–25 EU vine pull-out subsidy and flag abandonment risk.
candidates.reason: Missing-vine / dead-vine detection from UAV imagery has published baselines; national orthophoto multi-year change for grubbing-up verification is less explored but must be confirmed. Aerial cadence (BD ORTHO ~3-yearly) may be too slow for a 2024–25 scheme.
candidates.reframe: Combine scales: use BD ORTHO 20 cm for the baseline row geometry and Sentinel-2 / AlphaEarth for the in-between years to detect the grubbing event date, then use the next orthophoto to confirm. Output: per-parcel {grubbed, abandoned-standing, active} with date. This cross-scale event dating is the technical delta.

candidates.one_liner: Hedgerow and tree-line loss/gain detection for CAP GAEC 8 from multi-year open national orthophotos (FR 20 cm, NL 8 cm) against LPIS landscape-feature layers.
candidates.reason: France (IGN, Observatoire de la haie) and the Netherlands already produce hedgerow layers from orthophotos; change detection between epochs is the natural next step and may already be published. High crowding risk.
candidates.reframe: Only survives if the contribution is a CROSS-COUNTRY benchmark (FR 20 cm + NL 8 cm + DK) with a shared label protocol and a model that transfers across resolutions and GSDs — i.e. the resolution-transfer problem, not hedgerow detection itself. Drop if the adversarial search finds an existing multi-country hedgerow benchmark.

candidates.one_liner: Orchard tree count / age / gap inventory from open orthophotos.
candidates.reason: Restates D09 with a different crop; tree-crown inventory from aerial is mature.

candidates.one_liner: Paddy growth-stage classification from IMPaCT drone images.
candidates.reason: Off-the-shelf classifier on one dataset; one sentence.

candidates.one_liner: Map Lim Chu Kang farm plots, structures and land-use intensity from Singapore aerial basemap imagery to support master-plan re-parcelling.
candidates.reason: No named, licence-clear sub-metre imagery source for analytical use over Lim Chu Kang (OneMap/SLA basemap tiles are display-licensed). Fails C2 extra_check. Would flip to CONDITIONAL if SLA research access or an open sub-metre tile is confirmed; the non-imagery version of this problem is G01.

candidates.one_liner: Exploit opportunistic RGB frames captured by Namo Drone Didi spray drones as a free crop-monitoring by-product.
candidates.reason: No such open data exists and spray flights have no overlap/geometry; would collapse to generic RGB stress detection.

candidates.one_liner: Ablation: does NIR/red-edge beat RGB for maize weed segmentation on WeedsGalore?
candidates.reason: One-sentence experiment on a public dataset.

candidates.one_liner: View-angle (BRDF) invariant vegetation indices from multi-view UAV multispectral frames.
candidates.reason: A June-2026 arXiv paper already extracts multi-angular reflectance from raw UAV sub-images.

candidates.one_liner: Multi-objective re-parcelling optimiser for the Lim Chu Kang agri-food cluster: assign farm types to parcels to maximise output under shared-facility co-location, waste→input circularity flows, and ecological buffer distance to Sungei Buloh / Kranji.
candidates.reason: C1 exempt; not generic; explicitly listed in constraints.yml opens_up; no obvious prior work — needs check.

candidates.one_liner: Energy-price-aware crop scheduling for vertical farms.
candidates.reason: Well-funded incumbents (constraints.yml warning); no delta vs commercial products.

candidates.one_liner: Camera-based disease detection for indoor leafy greens.
candidates.reason: Auto-fail pattern: generic disease detection.
